images-of-text

Whether an image holds text is in its pixels, which no case here can show: the rule asks only where markup gives a sign.

A. Asked about (cantTell)

01 — CANTTELL: an input type="image", a button drawn as an image
02 — CANTTELL: an img showing an SVG data URL whose markup holds text
03 — CANTTELL: the same SVG, base64-encoded, with alt=""

B. Not asked about

04 — NEUTRAL: a photo, whose pixels markup can't show
05 — NEUTRAL: an SVG data URL with shapes and no text
06 — NEUTRAL: an inline svg with text, which is real text
07 — NEUTRAL: an input type="image" inside display:none
08 — NEUTRAL: an input type="submit", a button of real text
